messages.subject: Out of stock items
messages.text:
Hello there!

We are looking to make a pollinator garden this year and I’ve been watching your site since last summer. 2 items I would like to get are still out of stock. When do you replenish or think these would be available?

Thank you,

Tonya DeRemer

messages.subject: Re: Out of stock items
messages.text:
Hello Tonya!
 

 That’s wonderful — a pollinator garden is such a great initiative 🌸 We’re happy to hear you’ve been following along since last summer!
 

 Could you please let us know which two items you’re looking for? I may be able to verify availability more precisely for you.
 

 We’re about to enter our horticultural campaign for the season, so some items will be replenished soon. Once I know the specific products, I can give you a better idea of timing.
 

 Looking forward to helping you plan your garden!
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay

messages.subject: Re: Out of stock items
messages.text:
Hi Tonya,

I'm really sorry, this reply is unacceptably late and you deserved much better than that. Probably too late, but just in case:

Here's where things stand on the four items you mentioned:

- Common Milkweed Bombs and Butterfly Milkweed Bombs (Asclepias syriaca and tuberosa): Available except in the USA 
- Hummingbird & Pollinator Bombs and Renaturalization Bombs: Discontinued 

You can also always order regular milkweed seed packets: Common (Syriaca), Butterfly (Tuberosa), Swamp (Incarnata) and several other species are available here: https://lasclay.com/en-us/products/milkweed-seeds

Let me know which species interest you most and I'll make sure we get you sorted before the season is over.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
